description: This file defines a data structure and parsing logic for processing assistant chat texts, including handling special tags like <think> and <final> to distinguish between different content types within the chat messages.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A struct representing a segment of assistant text, categorized as either thinking or response, with a unique identifier and string content.

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses raw input string into an array of AssistantTextSegments, optionally including 'thinking' segments based on the flag.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns only the segments that are visible, excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Checks whether the input string contains any visible (non-thinking) content, optionally including thinking segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Checks whether the input string has visible content, excluding thinking segments.

calls: self.findTagStart(tag: "think", closing: false, in: raw, from: cursor)
self.findTagStart(tag: "think", closing: true, in: raw, from: cursor)
self.findTagStart(tag: "final", closing: false, in: raw, from: cursor)
self.findTagStart(tag: "final", closing: true, in: raw, from: cursor)
